Title: Generally available: Up to 50 test fail criteria in Azure Load Testing

Body.Content:
Azure Load Testing now supports specifying up to 50 test fail criteria in your load tests. This allows you to easily set up multiple failure thresholds across several requests and metrics.

Learn more.
